images.title: Equal slanting sides give equal base angles
images.purpose: Shows isosceles trapezium UVWX with UX = VW, ∠U = ∠V = 65° and ∠W = ∠X = 115°, with the two dropped perpendiculars.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. One large isosceles trapezium in the centre with two dashed perpendiculars and its four angles marked.
images.exact_structure: One isosceles trapezium UVWX in dark outline: the long bottom side UV and the shorter top side XW are thick teal (#0072B2) lines, each with one identical arrowhead showing they are parallel. U is bottom left, V bottom right, W top right, X top left. The equal slanting sides UX and VW each carry one short tick mark. From X and from W a dashed grey (#6B7280) line drops straight down to UV, each with a tiny square right angle mark at its foot. Angle arcs in amber (#E69F00): 65° at U and 65° at V; in reddish purple (#CC79A7): 115° at X and 115° at W. The letters U, V, W, X sit outside their corners. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: In an isosceles trapezium the base angles are equal, and each top angle is 180° minus the angle below it.
images.description: Shows isosceles trapezium UVWX with UX = VW, ∠U = ∠V = 65° and ∠W = ∠X = 115°, with the two dropped perpendiculars.

image_decisions.why: The dropped perpendiculars and the matching angle colours show the congruent right triangles and equal angles.
